info.description: One API over all hosts, with the inbox and a key-value store. Everything under /v1/hosts/{name}/ that is not named here is that host's own API, passed through unchanged; only the `secrets` task is refused, which the host's `secrets` action stands in for. What can be done to a host or to the installation is listed at /v1/hosts/{name}/actions and /v1/actions, and run by POST to an action's name there. Over TCP every request carries the server's token or an OAuth 2.0 access token as a bearer, and needs the role its operation names. The routes of the setup key take that key as the bearer instead.
